export_scope: Derived, sanitized closed clear-track calibration evidence; not a final traffic-race result.

selection.criterion: Complete valid lap with zero actual two-wheel-center violations, no resets/collisions/source errors; choose faster observed clean lap. Capture quality reported separately; selected8 dominates10 in both pace and capture.
selection.selection_scope: One standing lap for each of three predeclared software lateral budgets; not a multi-seed champion or traffic-race promotion.
selection.software_coupling: Lateral budget retimes path speeds and also scales the software steering-correction budget before its unchanged friction estimate; this is not an isolated speed-profile-only ablation.

rejected_runs.wide10-calibrated-001: Clean but slower and less nominal capture than selected8

corner_anchor_definition.method: All original-map absolute-curvature peaks with height>.018/m, prominence>.009/m, separation>=25 original samples;18 fixed anchors, no performance-based selection.
corner_anchor_definition.pose_observation: Physical saved10Hz pose/speed/yaw interpolated at identical original-progress crossing; circular yaw interpolation.

white_line_metric_definition.road: Exact generated tarmac/white-line ribbon; kerbs excluded.
white_line_metric_definition.legality: At least two actual wheel contact centers inside; finite-patch physics is not modeled.
white_line_metric_definition.inside_pair_gap: Minimum signed gap of the corner-inside front/rear wheel centers to inside white line; negative can be legal when the other pair remains inside.
white_line_metric_definition.retained_pair_clearance: Maximum of left/right same-side-pair minimum signed distance to nearest white boundary; positive means that complete pair remains inside.
white_line_metric_definition.timing: Corner clearance uses interpolated10Hz physical poses. Whole-lap qualification comes from exact supervisor50Hz contact counts.

old_clear_baseline.name: baseline8-clear
old_clear_baseline.legacy_track_rule: 6m absolute original-reference error; not the new two-tyre rule

wide8-calibrated-001.comparison_scope: Combined new line, profile scheduling, mapped-route controller, K calibration and tyre rule; same physical vehicle, map, standing grid pose and learned weights. Not an isolated steering/model ablation.

wide10-calibrated-001.comparison_scope: Combined new line, profile scheduling, mapped-route controller, K calibration and tyre rule; same physical vehicle, map, standing grid pose and learned weights. Not an isolated steering/model ablation.

wide12-calibrated-001.comparison_scope: Combined new line, profile scheduling, mapped-route controller, K calibration and tyre rule; same physical vehicle, map, standing grid pose and learned weights. Not an isolated steering/model ablation.

limitations: Same8m/s² label does not mean identical prior driver or qualification; broader road rule, line and controller changed.
18 fixed-corner speed mean/median is not a lap-time average; combined system result, one standing lap per configuration.
Understeer K is an empirical command-response approximation; no measured wheel-angle/tire-force model or real F1 equivalence.
Old20car001 values are traffic context only; no old-vs-new traffic superiority claim from these clear laps.
redactions: Source filesystem location map and raw-trace hash index omitted.
Interpolated map positions, yaw, race/sample timestamps, nominal-point coordinates and individual wheel-coordinate records omitted.
Derived corner metrics and source/module/artifact hashes retained; source_audit_sha256 identifies the original audit, not this sanitized file.
